name: Haramase no Kuni ♪ Tanetsuke Park e Youkoso!

source:
A whole theme park to yourself! No lines, no crowds, and dripping hungry snatches as far as the eye can see! Seem too good to be true? Well, not for our protagonist Kazuya and his certified extra-fertile spooge. In an effort to keep the birth rate up, places like this (and maybe some shopping districts) have been set up for well endowed individuals so they can do their part by impregnating people 24/7!

Rina will give you the tour! From water slides to ferris wheels, each attraction has a sexy twist! There's a petting zoo full of chicks in cosplay and a merry-go-round, where instead of riding a pony you’ll find a cutie ready and waiting to take a ride on you. So what are you waiting for? Come on down to Pussy Paradise Park~!
